Book 19 (子張), first part (units 0–19, passages 19.1–19.19) — keys lacking a glossary entry, with the reading used and where.
(unit numbers are 0-based UNITS indexes for the whole book; passage in brackets)

## Bound compounds (new keys)
儼然    yǎn rán       grave, dignified in look (Zhu Xi 儼然者貌之莊; as 喟然, 憮然)  — u8 (19.9)
堂堂    táng táng     imposing, grand in looks and bearing (Zhu Xi 堂堂容貌之盛)  — u16 (19.16)
言游    yán yóu       Yan You: Ziyou, called by his surname 言 and the 游 of his courtesy name (in Zixia's mouth)  — u12 (19.12)
孟莊子  mèng zhuāng zǐ  Meng Zhuangzi: Zhongsun Su 仲孫速, grandee of Lu, son of Meng Xianzi (Zhu Xi 孟莊子魯大夫名速其父獻子名蔑; Ma Rong 孟荘子鲁大夫仲孫速也)  — u18 (19.18)
孟氏    mèng shì      the Meng: the Mengsun house of Lu (as 季氏, 孔氏)  — u19 (19.19)
陽膚    yáng fū       Yang Fu: a disciple of Master Zeng, made officer of justice by the Meng (Zhu Xi 陽膚曽子弟子; Bao Xian 陽膚曽子弟子也)  — u19 (19.19)

## Single characters (new keys)
拒  jù     to turn away, to refuse, to keep off (可者與之其不可者拒之; He Yan's text writes 距)  — u2 ×3 (19.3)
尊  zūn    to honour, to hold in esteem (尊賢)  — u2 (19.3)
嘉  jiā    to praise, to commend; fine, excellent (嘉善)  — u2 (19.3)
泥  nì     to get stuck, not to get through (Zhu Xi 泥去聲…泥不通也; Bao Xian 泥難不通也); read ní 'mud'  — u3 (19.4)  [polyphone: ní/nì — for POLY]
儼  yǎn    grave, dignified (in 儼然)  — u8 (19.9)
謗  bàng   to speak ill of, to malign (以為謗己也)  — u9 (19.10)
閑  xián   a rail, a barrier that stops things going out and in (Zhu Xi 閑闌也所以止物之出入); a rule (Kong Anguo 閑猶法也)  — u10 (19.11)
洒  sǎ     to sprinkle (water on the floor) (洒掃; Zhu Xi 洒色賣反, pointing to shài; modern sǎ)  — u11 (19.12)  [polyphone: also xǐ 'to wash' — for POLY]
掃  sǎo    to sweep (洒掃; Zhu Xi 掃素報反, pointing to sào; modern sǎo; Ruan writes 埽)  — u11 (19.12)  [polyphone: sǎo/sào — for POLY]
應  yìng   to respond, to answer (應對 'responding and answering' to elders and guests)  — u11 (19.12)  [polyphone: yìng/yīng — for POLY]
區  qū     a kind, a class (Zhu Xi 區猶類也: 區以别矣 'they are told apart by kinds'); read ōu as a surname  — u12 (19.12)  [polyphone: qū/ōu — for POLY]
誣  wū     to deceive, to misrepresent (焉可誣也; Zhu Xi 誣之 'to deceive (the learner)'; Ma Rong 焉可使誣 'how can it be misrepresented')  — u12 (19.12)
卒  zú     the end, to finish (有始有卒); also a foot-soldier  — u12 (19.12)  [polyphone: zú/cù — for POLY]
散  sàn    to scatter, to come apart (民散久矣; Zhu Xi 民散謂情義乖離不相維繫; Ma Rong 民之離散); read sǎn 'loose'  — u19 (19.19)  [polyphone: sàn/sǎn — for POLY]

## Existing keys used in a sense the entry does not cover (please broaden by addition)
致   'to carry to the utmost, to go to the limit' (君子學以致其道, u6 19.7, Zhu Xi 致極也; 喪致乎哀, u14 19.14, Zhu Xi 致極其哀; 人未有自致者也, u17 19.17, Zhu Xi 致盡其極也); 致命 'to hand over one's life' (u0 19.1; Zhu Xi 致命謂委致其命猶言授命也)
命   'one's life', in 致命 'to hand over one's life' (士見危致命, u0 19.1)
與   yǔ 'to keep company with, to associate with' (可者與之, u2 19.3)
矜   jīn 'to pity, to feel for' (矜不能, u2 19.3; 哀矜而勿喜, u19 19.19; Ma Rong 當哀矜之)
容   'to tolerate, to have room for (people)' (容衆, 何所不容, u2 19.3) — the entry has 'to hold, to have room for'; add the sense with people
肆   'a workshop, the place where craftsmen work' (百工居肆, u6 19.7; Zhu Xi 肆謂官府造作之處)
文   wén 'to gloss over, to dress up (a fault)' (小人之過也必文, u7 19.8; Zhu Xi 文去聲…文飾之也, i.e. wèn — modern wén given)
厲   'exacting, firm (in speech)' (聽其言也厲, u8 19.9; Zhu Xi 厲者辭之確; Zheng Xuan 厲嚴正也); 'to afflict, to ill-use' (以為厲己也, u9 19.10; Zhu Xi 厲猶病也; Wang Su 厲病也)
信   'to be trusted' (君子信而後勞其民, 信而後諫, u9 19.10; Zhu Xi 信謂誠意惻怛而人信之也)
勞   'to set (people) to work, to labour them' (勞其民, u9 19.10)
變   'a change (of aspect)' (君子有三變, u8 19.9) — the entry has 'to change'; add the noun
本   as a verb, 'to trace to the root' (本之則無, u11 19.12)
過   'to be wrong, to go too far' (言游過矣, u12 19.12)
親   'one's parents' (親喪, u17 19.17)
他   'the rest, the other (parts)' (其他可能也, u18 19.18)
